instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph with a full-length, eye-level view captures three family members against a draped beige fabric backdrop. On the left, the younger woman with medium-length brown hair (R2) in a white button-up shirt and wide-leg blue jeans stands barefoot, holding the young girl with light brown hair (R3). The young girl (R3), wearing a white blouse and blue jeans, is carried horizontally. On the right, the older woman with short dark hair and bangs (R1) in a long white shirt and blue jeans stands barefoot, helping support the young girl. The younger woman and the older woman smile warmly as they jointly hold the child between them. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates the scene, creating a warm, minimalist aesthetic with gentle shadows.
